app.name: HiveBuzz
app.tagline: Alerts, TTS and automation for your TikTok LIVE

feed.title: Live events

feed.emptyFilter: No events from this platform yet.

simulator.hint: Generates fake events to test overlays and rules without being live.
simulator.sent: Sent: see it in the event list and in your overlays.

settings.overlaysHint: Copy the URL and paste it as a Browser Source in OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio. It contains your token: don't share it.
settings.eulerHint: Optional. Without it the free tier is used. Stored in the system keyring, not in the database.
settings.portHint: Only listens on 127.0.0.1. The change applies after restarting HiveBuzz.
settings.serverError: The local server could not start

trigger.commandHint: With or without «!». Whatever is typed after it ends up in {args}.
trigger.apiHint: Fired with POST /api/trigger and this name (letters, numbers, - and _). See the Integrations tab.

cond.rolesHint: One is enough. None checked = everyone.

rules.title: Rules
rules.empty: No rules yet. Create one to react to gifts, follows, commands and more.

tested.dropped: «{{name}}»: the queue is full, it was dropped.

editor.name: Name
editor.conditionsHint: All of them must be met for the rule to run.
editor.queueHint: How this rule competes with the others to run.
editor.ttlHint: If it waits longer than this in the queue, it is dropped

action.soundsHint: If you check several, one is picked at random.
action.noSounds: No sounds. Import them in the Library tab.
action.jsonHint: This action type has no form yet.
action.jsonObject: It must be a JSON object
action.amountHint: Number or variable, e.g. {coins}. Negative values allowed.
action.jsonInvalid: Invalid JSON (not applied until it is valid)
action.spinWheelHint: Spins the wheel configured in «Bot & points». It has no parameters.
action.botTextHint: The bot writes it in chat (needs the TikTok session). Variables allowed.
action.pointsAmountHint: Signed integer or variable, e.g. -50 or {coins}
action.pointsTargetHint: @user or variable; empty = whoever triggers the rule
action.webhookBodyHint: Texts accept variables and are escaped automatically.
action.webhookHeadersHint: E.g.: {"Authorization": "Bearer …"}. Stored with the rule, not in the keyring.
action.netMessageHint: Text with variables. For safe JSON use «messageJson» in the advanced editor.
action.keysHint: A combination like ctrl+shift+f5. Several, comma-separated, are pressed in order.
action.targetWindowsHint: Text from the title or .exe of the active window (comma-separated). If the active window doesn't match, nothing is sent.
action.anyWindowWarning: Dangerous: the keys go to whatever is in the foreground (browser, chat…).

library.soundsHint: mp3, wav, ogg or flac files. They are copied to HiveBuzz's data folder.
library.mediaHint: For overlay alerts (png, jpg, gif, webp, mp4, webm).

tts.enginesHint: Piper is offline and good quality; on Windows the system voices (SAPI) and, optionally, Edge-TTS are also available.
tts.piperManual: Install Piper manually and set its path.
tts.chatReaderHint: Reads aloud the comments that meet these filters. The «Text to speech» actions in rules work even if this is off.
tts.commandHint: E.g.: tts → only «!tts hello» messages are read. Empty = the whole chat.
tts.rolesHint: One role is enough. None checked = everyone.
tts.recentDonorsHint: Only people who gifted in the last N minutes
tts.ignoreBang: Don't read messages starting with «!» (other bots' commands)
tts.randomPoolHint: Each user always gets the same voice from this list.
tts.filtersHint: Applied to everything that is read, whether from chat or from a rule.
tts.profanityMode: If there is a bad word
tts.profanityWordsHint: Comma-separated. Ignores case, accents and repeated letters.

overlays.urlHint: Add this URL as a Browser Source in OBS or TikTok LIVE Studio. Changes show instantly, no reload.
overlays.confirmReset: Go back to this overlay's default values?
overlays.noServer: The local server is not available.
overlays.copyFailed: Could not copy to the clipboard.
overlays.previewHintTest: Preview at 1920×1080. Use «Test» to send it sample content.
overlays.previewHintLive: Preview at 1920×1080. This overlay shows real data.

field.title: Title
field.showPlatform: Show which platform it comes from (TikTok / Twitch)

goals.title: Goals
goals.hint: Progress bars for likes, follows, coins… They notify rules (the «Goal reached» trigger) when completed.
goals.name: Name

onReachHint.stop: Notifies only once and keeps counting.
onReachHint.reset: Keeps the surplus and starts another round.
onReachHint.extend: The target goes up and it keeps accumulating.

goals.resetOnSession: Start from zero on every new LIVE

timers.title: Timers / subathon
timers.hint: A countdown that gifts, follows, etc. can extend. At zero the «Timer ended» trigger fires.
timers.maxHint: The remaining time never exceeds it. Empty = no cap.
timers.extensionsHint: Only adds while the timer is running or paused.

session.title: Session
session.hint: A new session starts by itself when reconnecting after a LIVE ends. Here you can force it or clear the donor history.
session.confirmNew: Start a new session? The session ranking is emptied and goals that ask for it are reset.
session.confirmClear: Clear ALL donor history (day and all time)? This cannot be undone.

bot.title: Chatbot
bot.hint: Writes in your chat. Needs a TikTok login (TikTok session section).

points.title: Points system
points.hint: Viewers earn points and redeem them for rewards.
points.rewardsHint: Rewards are created in Rules: put a points cost on a chat-command rule.

wheel.title: Prize wheel
wheel.hint: Launch it with a rule («spinWheel» action) or with the test button.
wheel.actionHint: For a prize to run actions, edit its plan in the advanced configuration.

poll.title: Polls
poll.hint: Viewers vote by typing the option's number.
poll.question: Question

login.title: TikTok session
login.hint: Optional: only needed for the bot to write. The password is typed on TikTok's website; HiveBuzz only stores the session cookies in the system keyring.
login.opened: Log in in the window and press «I've logged in».
login.reconnect: Reconnect to the LIVE to apply the session.

obs.title: OBS Studio
obs.hint: Controlled through obs-websocket v5 (included in OBS 28 or later). Used by the «OBS Studio» actions.
obs.passwordSaved: One is saved in the system keyring.
obs.passwordNone: Empty = no password. Stored in the keyring, never in the database.
obs.help: In OBS: Tools → WebSocket Server Settings → Enable. If OBS is on another machine, use its IP; traffic is not encrypted.

api.title: Local API
api.hint: Trigger rules from scripts, Streamer.bot or mods. Create a rule with the «Local API call» trigger.
api.triggerHint: JSON body: name (required) and vars (text, number or boolean; used as {user}…). Returns 202 if queued, 404 if no active rule uses the name.
api.wsHint: Emits the normalized events (LiveEvent) as JSON.
api.security: It only listens on 127.0.0.1 and requires the token; don't share it (it's in the overlay URLs).

stats.hint: One per LIVE (split when reconnecting after a LIVE ends).
stats.pick: Pick a stream from the list.

spotify.title: Spotify
spotify.clientIdHint: Your Spotify app's Client ID. It is public: no secret is needed.
spotify.redirectHint: Copy it exactly into your Spotify app's “Redirect URIs”.
spotify.opened: Authorize in the browser; this screen will update by itself.
spotify.blockedTerms: Block if the title or artist contains
spotify.testHint: Searches and adds to your real Spotify queue, skipping roles and points.
spotify.help: Overlay: «Now playing» in the Overlays tab. Spotify only allows queueing with a Premium account and an active device.
spotify.hintEasy: Connect your account and your chat will be able to request songs with !sr. You'll see what's playing in the «Now playing» overlay.
spotify.enabledEasy: Let chat request songs (!sr song name)
spotify.usage: Your viewers type !sr and the song name or link; !song says what's playing. Spotify must be open and playing, and the queue only works with Spotify Premium.
spotify.advanced: Advanced options (use my own Spotify app)
spotify.needsSetup: Before connecting, set up your Spotify app (below). It's free and you only do it once.
spotify.builtinNote: You're using the Spotify app bundled with this version. If you get “403”, your account isn't allowed in it: set up your own app (below).
spotify.setupTitle: Set up my Spotify app (free, one time)
spotify.setupIntro: Spotify requires each streamer to use their own app for HiveBuzz to control their music. It takes about 2 minutes:
spotify.step1: Sign in with your Spotify account at
spotify.step2: Click “Create app”: any name and description, tick “Web API” and accept the terms.
spotify.step3: Paste the address shown below into “Redirect URIs” and save.
spotify.step4: In “Settings → User Management” add the name and email of your Spotify account (without this Spotify answers “403 Forbidden”).
spotify.step5: Copy your app's “Client ID”, paste it below, click Save and then “Connect with Spotify”.
spotify.forbiddenHelp: Getting “403”? The account you connected isn't in the app's “User Management”, or the app owner's account has no Premium (Spotify requires it for apps in development mode). If you change the Client ID you'll need to connect again.

prefs.title: Application
prefs.languageHint: Interface and overlay texts (overlays take their language from ?lang=en in their URL).
prefs.closeToTray: When closing the window, keep running in the system tray
prefs.startMinimized: When starting with the system, start minimized

update.title: Updates

profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.hint: Save your rules and overlay configuration under a name («Minecraft», «Just chatting»…) and switch between them in one go. They don't include goals, timers, points, bot or wheel.
profiles.saveCurrent: Save current state as a profile
profiles.updated: Profile updated with the current state.
profiles.confirmApply: Applying «{{name}}» replaces ALL your rules and your overlay configuration. Continue?
profiles.confirmOverwrite: Overwrite «{{name}}» with your current rules and overlays?

backup.title: Export / import configuration
backup.hint: A single .zip file with rules, goals, timers, overlays, profiles, settings, and your sounds and images.
backup.summary: {{rules}} rules · {{goals}} goals · {{timers}} timers · {{overlays}} overlays · {{sounds}} sounds · {{media}} images · {{profiles}} profiles
backup.pending: Import ready. It will be applied on restart and will REPLACE your rules, goals, timers, overlays, libraries and profiles.
backup.noticeError: Could not import: {{error}}. Your previous configuration was kept.
backup.warning: The file doesn't include passwords, tokens or sessions (they live in the system keyring), but it does include whatever you put in rules, such as a webhook's headers. Viewers and points are not exported.

offer.title: First time in HiveBuzz?
offer.body: We'll show you the app in a couple of minutes, step by step, trying it yourself.

welcome.title: Welcome to HiveBuzz!
welcome.body: I'll show you the basics in a couple of minutes. You can leave any time with «Exit» or the Esc key, and repeat it from «Help».

connections.title: Connect your streams
connections.body: This is where you connect TikTok and Twitch. Type your username or channel and press Connect. Below you'll see the status in plain words.

simulate.title: Try it without being live
simulate.body: Open this box and press any button: HiveBuzz will send a fake event, as if someone gifted or typed in your chat.

feed.title: What's happening, live
feed.body: Every gift, message or follow shows up here. If you use TikTok and Twitch at once, you can filter by platform.

menu.title: The menu
menu.body: Everything else is in this menu, grouped by what you want to do. At the bottom you can always see whether TikTok and Twitch are connected.

goRules.title: Open Rules
goRules.body: Rules are the heart of HiveBuzz. Click «Rules» in the menu to see them.

help.body: Here's the explanation of every screen, a glossary and quick answers. You can also repeat this tour whenever you like.

finish.title: All set!
finish.body: You know the basics. Start by connecting your stream and creating your first rule; the «Getting started» list on Home guides you.

tour.title: Interactive tour
tour.body: A few-minute walk through the app: you connect, try an alert and get to know every part of the menu.

menu.title: What's in each part of the menu
menu.hint: Everything you'll find, screen by screen.

dashboard.what: Here you connect your streams and see everything that happens, live.
dashboard.i1: A card for TikTok and another for Twitch: type your username and press Connect.
dashboard.i2: The status of each connection in plain words.
dashboard.i3: The event list (gifts, messages, followers…) as they happen.
dashboard.i4: A simulator to try everything without being live, and the getting-started list.

rules.what: Here you decide what happens when something occurs in your stream: «when X happens, do Y».
rules.i1: Triggers: gifts, follows, chat commands, keywords, likes and more.
rules.i2: Actions: sound, on-screen alert, voice, bot message, key press, OBS, webhook…
rules.i3: Conditions: cooldown, roles, probability and schedule.
rules.i4: A «Test» button to see a rule in action without waiting for it to happen.

goals.what: Progress bars and countdowns your community fills up.
goals.i1: Goals for likes, follows, coins or a specific gift.
goals.i3: When completed they can fire a rule (for example, a celebration).
goals.i4: They save themselves: you don't lose progress when closing the app.

interact.what: Everything that makes your chat more fun.
interact.i1: Chatbot: commands like !discord, automatic replies and thank-yous.
interact.i2: Points: your viewers earn them and redeem them for rewards.
interact.i3: Prize wheel and polls that are voted by typing a number.
interact.i4: TikTok session: only needed if you want the bot to write in your chat.

stats.what: A summary of every stream, to see how it went.
stats.i3: Gifts by type and chat activity.
stats.i4: You can delete the summaries you don't want.

overlays.what: What your audience sees on screen: alerts, chat, goals…
overlays.i1: Alerts, chat, gifts, goals, timer, wheel, polls and «Now playing».
overlays.i2: Each one has its own address: copy it into OBS as a «Browser» source.
overlays.i3: Change colors, font, size and position while watching the live preview.
overlays.i4: You can show which platform each message comes from.

library.i1: Sounds (mp3, wav, ogg, flac) with their own volume and a listen button.
library.i2: Images, GIFs and videos for alerts.
library.i3: Files are copied into HiveBuzz's folder.
library.i4: They travel with you when you export your configuration.

tts.what: Have HiveBuzz read messages out loud (text to speech).
tts.i1: Free voices without internet (Piper) and the system ones.
tts.i2: It can read chat with filters: commands only, subscribers, moderators…
tts.i3: Filters for profanity, links and emojis.
tts.i4: A «Skip» button to cut what's playing.

integrations.i1: OBS: switch scenes or show sources from a rule.
integrations.i2: Spotify: your viewers request songs with !sr and you see what's playing.
integrations.i3: Local API: other programs can trigger your rules.
integrations.i4: Advanced Twitch: use your own application (almost nobody needs it).

settings.i1: Language, start with Windows and system tray.
settings.i2: Profiles: switch all your rules and overlays at once («Minecraft», «Just chatting»).
settings.i3: Export and import your whole configuration.
settings.i4: Updates, logs and the Euler Stream key.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.hint: The words you'll see around the app.

event.def: Something that happens in your stream: a gift, a message, a follower…

rule.def: An automatic order: «when X happens, do Y».

trigger.def: The «when» of a rule: what sets it off.

action.def: The «do» of a rule: sound, alert, voice, message…

overlay.def: A layer on top of your stream (alerts, chat, goals). It's added to OBS by its address.

session.def: One stream. HiveBuzz starts a new one when reconnecting after the previous one ended.

points.def: Your community's currency: earned by watching and commenting, redeemed for rewards.

tts.def: Text to speech: reading messages out loud.

cooldown.def: The waiting time before a rule can repeat.

obs.q: How do I put an alert in OBS?
obs.a: Go to Overlays, pick «Alerts» and press Copy. In OBS add a «Browser» source, paste the address and set 1920×1080.

bot.a: It starts off: turn it on in «Bot & points» and log in to TikTok on that same screen. On Twitch the bot doesn't write (read-only).

spotify.a: For viewers to add songs to the queue, yes: that's a Spotify limitation. Without Premium you only see what's playing.

safe.a: Everything runs on your PC. Passwords and sessions are stored in the system keyring, overlays require a token, and HiveBuzz never asks for your TikTok or Twitch password.

test.q: How do I test without being live?
test.a: On Home, open «Try without being live» and press any button. You can also use «Test» inside each rule.

update.q: Do I lose my stuff if I update?
update.a: No: your data lives in a separate folder. Still, you can export a backup in Settings before updating.
